profile.headline: Apprentice Full-Stack Developer at Launch Academy, Inc.
profile.summary:
After graduating from college I devoted my time and efforts to teaching and helping middle school students access maths in Boston.  After a love-hate relationship with teaching, I am working on transitioning my career to that of a full-stack developer by learning coding practices at Launch Academy in Boston.  So far I have loved the learning process as part of Launch Academy and particularly getting to work on our group and individual coding projects.  My technical skills as well as practical skills are growing with each standup meeting, bug fix, coding struggle and group success and I could not be more excited to start looking for a programming job in the next weeks!

Specialties:
-Ruby
-JavaScript
-Github
-HTML/CSS

positions.title: Apprentice Full-Stack Developer
positions.description:
+Learned to program using modern languages and technologies such as Ruby on Rails, JavaScript, React, Web Sockets, Action Cables, Git, and more
+Gained experience collaborating through group projects, pair programming, and working on my own individual project
+Utilized Git and GitHub to support both group and individual workflow.

positions.title: Mathematics Teacher
positions.description:
+Supported the teaching and management of student learning in 8th grade Math classes
+Created supplemental assignments, provided push-in, and pull-out support
+Fulfilled additional school-wide responsibilities such as running an advisory section, teaching a separate remedial Math class, and communicating frequently with families about student academic and behavioral progress.

positions.title: Long Term Substitute Teacher
positions.description:
+Taught mathematics and managed student learning and behavior for four sections of 16-20 students
+Worked closely with the math specialist and special educator to meet the needs of all students
+Fulfilled additional responsibilities such as running a homeroom, leading advisory lessons, taking part in grade, content, and parent meetings.

positions.title: Learning Specialist
positions.description:
+Supported the teaching and management of student learning in Grades 6 through 8 Math classes during the first semester and in Grade 6 Math and English Language Arts during the second semester
+Accommodated and modified classwork, created supplemental assignments, provided push-in and pull-out support, and supplied any additional supports to meet student and IEP/504 needs
+Attended IEP/504 meetings
+Measured, updated, wrote IEP goals and progress reports 
+Continued to fulfill additional school-wide responsibilities such as running an advisory section, teaching a separate remedial Math class, and communicating frequently with families about student academic and behavioral progress

company.name: Roxbury Prep Charter School, Uncommon Schools

positions.title: Mathematics Teacher
positions.description:
+Taught Mathematics and managed student learning and behavior for three sections of 26-28 students each year
+Created and modified curriculum, materials and lesson plans for teaching sixth graders to master Common Core standards and take the PARCC and MCAS exams while remediating students behind grade level
+Worked closely with classroom learning specialists to determine and implement best practices for meeting the needs of all students
+Fulfilled additional school-wide responsibilities such as running an advisory section, teaching a separate remedial Math class, and communicating frequently with families about student academic and behavioral progress
+Supported the deans of students with school-wide behavior management.

company.name: Roxbury Prep Charter School, Uncommon Schools

projects.title: Math Mentors
projects.description:
Web project developed to connect students with other students to act as tutors with math concepts and homework questions through real time communication via Web Sockets and Action Cables.  Coming from a teaching in background I build this as an app that I wish I had been able to utilize at the schools I worked in.

github: https://github.com/ericluby/math_question_board

projects.title: Netflix Reviews
projects.description:
Collaborated with 4 others from Launch Academy to create a website to review and rate Netflix Shows.  Building out this project took lots of planning, communication and pair programming.

github: https://github.com/samuelgrieve1/netflix-reviews
